title: Prove the exact antipodal D16 spinor LP optimum (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with an exact finite linear-program certificate: the antipodal length-sixteen Delsarte relaxation for distances {2,6,8,10,14,16} has unique optimum **18432/29**.

```diff
  #2244: code upper bound 18432/29, rounded to 317 spinor lines
+ Exact primal optimizer: (A_2,A_6,A_8) = (750,2002,12870)/29
+ Antipodality and all two-point inequalities cannot improve that cap
```

The original bound-improvement attempt gives this sharp negative result. A smaller cap needs constraints outside the stated real relaxation. The optimizer is a distance distribution, not a code. Produced by Nick Petalas; credit DreamingOfClouds #2244 and its #2228/#2125/#968 lineage. The new deliverable is primal optimality and uniqueness, rather than an audit of the predecessor's cap.

## Evidence

- **Before:** #2244 provides an upper certificate without a matching primal or uniqueness statement.
- **After:** the exact primal satisfies all seventeen transforms. The identity `18432/29-N=(25L_2+L_6+2L_8)/116` proves the bound; positive multipliers and determinant -1900544 force the unique optimizer.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized verifiers pass, each under 0.03 seconds. They check 289 independently computed Krawtchouk coefficients, sixteen literal code pairs and five rejection controls. The registered package replay and committed-byte/source-history preflight also pass. Each run emits a fresh hash-bound receipt.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12 standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/antipodal-spinor-lp-optimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/antipodal-spinor-lp-optimum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/antipodal-spinor-lp-optimum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/antipodal-spinor-lp-optimum --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_ANTIPODAL_SPINOR_LP_OPTIMUM optimum=18432/29 unique=1 transforms=17 controls=5 no_new_kappa`.

## Limitations

The real two-point program has no integrality or three-point constraints. This does not improve the code bound, construct a code, prove 317 lines attainable, or supply a native decoder, compensation, routing, precision, stock, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem. The selected frontier is unchanged. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No Lean, Docker or selected operator replay was run.

The card's historical orientation command fails with `KeyError: 'complex_profile'` on the current selected schema; the current selected-baseline metadata check passes at 60403/20000000. That unrelated historical command is outside this new certificate. No changes to shared or frozen files are included.

## Open next questions

Can an integrality or three-point constraint exclude the unique optimizer and lower the 317-line cap? First test one explicit triple-distance consistency condition. No larger search is included.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this antipodal spinor-code relaxation was found in the live open-PR checks and cached fully paginated corpus. #2244 is the merged predecessor; #606 studies full-shell spinor circuits under a different boundary. Sparse local-note coverage and unpublished work limit the search.

Completion refresh: this account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-23T12:27:28Z were listed again after CI. The nine other open PRs study different quantities. #5201 uses antipodal pairs in a signed connector argument, not a binary spinor-code distance distribution; no shared numerical result is compared. No additional computation was run to check other contributions.

Run metadata confirms the exact head and successful completion. The registered replay executes both normal and optimized exact checks. All registered commands and the committed-byte/source-history preflight also pass locally. The historical orientation failure above was not caused by this isolated addition. Hosted replay certifies these bounded checks; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. This adds one isolated package.

**Blast radius:** package. Shared code, frozen evidence and the selected result are unchanged.
